title: Undesirable Biases in NLP: Addressing Challenges of Measurement

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates existing gender bias measurement tools (e.g., word embedding geometric projections, semantic similarity in STS-B, and coreference resolution tasks in WinoBias) through the lens of psychometrics, analyzing their construct validity, internal consistency, and reliability.

The paper critically evaluates benchmark datasets (such as CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet) that measure various social biases by comparing language model probabilities for stereotype-consistent versus stereotype-inconsistent sentences, assessing their operationalization and content validity.
